title: Profetaq Wasinpi Sutichasqa
intro: Qhepa kaq willakuqpa wasinpi, kawsarqan huk alma, paypa sapan willakuyninmi llapa iñiqkunapaq hanaq pacha yachachikuyman tukupurqan. Kay figuraq kawsayninqa allintan tuparqan huk t’ikraq kamachikuywan, chaymi wiñaypaq mosoqmanta ruwarqan costumbres sociales nisqakunata, chaymi hatun t’ikrayta rikuchirqan imaynatas iñiyqa familiata, pertenece nisqatapas sut’inchanman chayta.
clues: Huk kutinmi sutiyqa huk noble lineamientowan tupachisqa karqan, ichaqa aswan hatun cheqaq kaqmi qhepaman sut’inchanman cheqaq iñiypa watasqa kayninta.
Ñuqaqa karqani hatun favorta chaskiqmi Allahmanta hinaspa kachasqanmanta, huk favorta lliwpa qayllanpi declarasqa karqan Libropi.
Casado kawsayniyqa huk prueba importantemanmi tukupurqan, chaymi wiñaypaq cambianman adoptasqa runakunaq imayna qhawarisqankuta.
Ñuqam karqani, paypa prueba personalniymi huk divina kamachikuyman apawarqa, chaymi Profetaman saqirqa huk warmiwan casarakunanpaq ripusqay qipata.
Willakuyniywanqa, llapa miraykunapaqmi sutillata qawachirqaku biológico aylluwan akllasqa aylluwan rakinakuyqa.
Ñuqallam kani compañeroykunamanta, sutinmi sutilla rikurin qipa revelacionpi, manam profeta hinachu, aswanqa pruebasqa hinaspa hatunchasqa sirviente hina.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
